title: Routing classifier: each keryx shell request is sorted into a routing category (Jev when connected, else the main model) and sent to that category's model

AC1.note: src/harness/decision/classifier.ts: TaskClassifier interface + NullClassifier, always {ok:false,reason:"no classifier configured"}. Test: classifier.test.ts (1 test, pass).

AC2.note: src/harness/decision/deterministic-shortcuts.ts: classifyDeterministic — slash bypass, chit-chat->quick, review-naming->review. Tests: deterministic-shortcuts.test.ts (9 tests incl. negative cases for 'overview' substring and long greeting-prefixed messages, pass).

AC3.note: src/harness/decision/main-model-classifier.ts: MainModelTaskClassifier on runModelTurn, strict one-token prompt, unparseable/out-of-vocab/empty -> ok:false. Tests: main-model-classifier.test.ts (6 tests: exact match, whitespace/casing noise, out-of-vocab, empty, no-categories, provider error, pass).

AC4.note: src/harness/decision/jev-classifier.ts: JevTaskClassifier built on existing callJevSystemOne (flow 306), one choice+one noul question, credential+opt-in gated, threshold refusal. Tests: jev-classifier.test.ts (6 tests, fake fetch, zero real network, pass). Threshold tuned 0.6->0.45 from live-check evidence (AC11).

AC5.note: src/harness/decision/classify-turn.ts: classifyTurn chain (deterministic->jev->main-model->null), each stage wrapped in withTimeout (default 3000ms, AbortController-based real cancellation). Tests: classify-turn.test.ts (9 tests incl. per-stage transitions and a hanging-fetch timeout case asserting <2s wall time, pass).

AC6.note: src/tui/routing-classifier-source.ts: runRoutingClassifierForTurn resolves via resolveCategoryDetailed({project,user}, connected) matching review/subagents' existing call-site pattern. sessionModelExplicit flag (set in tui-shell.ts's switchTo) skips classification entirely once /model is used this session. Tests: routing-classifier-source.test.ts (5 tests) + classify-turn.test.ts's slash-command/empty-category short-circuit tests.

AC7.note: tui-shell.ts: /route on|off registered in agent-commands.ts AGENT_SLASH_COMMANDS, dispatched via isRouteCommand, ShellConfig.routingClassifier.enabled persisted (shell-config.ts), routingEnabled local binding gates classification per turn. Tests: route-command.test.ts (5 tests); turn-guard-shell-wiring.test.ts and tui-shell.test.ts source-audits still pass unmodified/updated for the new call site.

AC8.note: renderRoutingTagLine (e.g. '[quick -> anthropic/claude-x] (jev 92%)') printed via io.onSystem when a turn routes; sb-route sidebar row (renderRoutingSidebarValue: 'on · N routed (last: cat)' / 'off') mounted after sb-guard. Tests: routing-classifier-source.test.ts asserts exact tag text and sidebar value strings for on/off/with-count states.

AC9.note: TaskClassifierUsage (inputTokens/outputTokens/cost/latencyMs) threaded from JevTaskClassifier (result.usage) and MainModelTaskClassifier (runModelTurn's NormalizedUsage+latencyMs) into TaskClassifierResult; renderRoutingUsageLine formats it. Tests: routing-classifier-source.test.ts asserts 'usage: ↑40 ↓0 $0.0012' for a Jev-routed turn; jev-classifier.test.ts asserts usage passthrough on both ok:true and refused results.

AC10.note: All 73 new tests use injected fetch/providerFactory stubs (fakeFetch mirroring jev-client.test.ts's own pattern; stubProvider mirroring single-turn.test.ts's own pattern) — zero real network calls. No OS-specific paths/shell assumptions (pure TS + tmpdir()/mkdtempSync for the one fs-touching test file). Revert-check: reverting src/harness/decision/*.ts and src/tui/routing-classifier-source.ts while keeping the *.test.ts files makes every new test fail red (module-not-found / missing export).

AC11.note: scripts/routing-classifier-live-check.ts run with env -u OPENROUTER_API_KEY (saved key resolved, key never printed): 20 hand-labeled requests across all 7 wired categories, 14 real Jev/systemone calls (well under ~40), final accuracy 20/20 (100%) after tuning DEFAULT_JEV_CLASSIFIER_CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD 0.6->0.45 based on measured evidence (first run at 0.6: 9/20=45%, every refused low-confidence pick's underlying choice was actually correct). Cost $0.000351 total, avg latency 412ms (well under the 3s bound). Findings documented in jev-classifier.ts's threshold constant comment.

AC12.note: docs/docs/cli-reference.md: new 'Routing classifier' paragraph (categories, fallback chain, /route on|off, ShellConfig.routingClassifier.enabled, per-turn tag + sidebar). check-doc-links: 1628 links checked, 0 broken. keryx health run: PASS (score 94). keryx flow check: consistent.
